model_note: Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct HF weights (the OSC.03 checkpoint), fp32 CPU, sdpa attention, raw completion (no chat template, no BOS: the Qwen tokenizer adds none). Neurons read at the mlp.down_proj INPUT act_fn(gate_proj(x)) * up_proj(x) via a forward pre-hook; flat neuron id = layer * 4864 + index.
c1_template_note: few = the 3 few-shot lines joined by newline (the same arithmetic register as the C2 probe). a is ZERO-PADDED to two digits so every prompt has the same 12 tokens and the same positions ('\n','0','7','+' for a=7): the last token is always '+', and the only thing that varies across a is the two digit tokens. Unpadded a would add a 1-digit vs 2-digit length step at a=10 (a positional confound with broadband low-frequency power). Read at the last token ('+'), where the model must hold a to add it.
peakiness_def: series over the axis (length N), rfft, drop the DC bin, peakiness = max bin power / total non-DC power (bins k=1..N/2, Nyquist included); dominant period = N/k of the max bin; a neuron with zero non-DC power gets peakiness 0
twin_note: random-init twin: AutoModelForCausalLM.from_config(same config) after torch.manual_seed(twin_seed) -- the HF Qwen2 init (normal std initializer_range, norms = 1), same tokenizer and prompts, run in a SEPARATE process (--twin) before the main run; its max peakiness over all 116736 neurons is null 2
c2_scoring: greedy argmax decode with KV cache (no generation_config: no repetition penalty), the leading digit run of the 4 new tokens must equal str(a+b) exactly
c2_random_pool: all 116736 neurons, excluding none (the top-64 may be drawn)
c2_ablation: zero the chosen neurons at the down_proj input (input * mask), every token position, prompt and generated
c3_doc_note: the sibling wiki.valid.raw of cell wikitext2_test_raw; article = text between top-level ' = Title = ' headings (the L4 round's split); doc = first 2048 tokens of its body. The 10th article with >= 2048 tokens, i.e. the first one after the 9 the L4 round used (ids 0,1,3,4,5,6,7,10,12)
c3_skip_note: positions 0-3 dropped from each series (the attention-sink positions; a one-position spike is broadband and says nothing about periodicity); series length 2044
c3_control: score = peakiness on the doc minus peakiness on the SAME 2048 tokens in shuffled order (one permutation, seed c3_shuffle_seed), a second forward pass -- kills sequence rhythm, keeps the token multiset
c3_test: hypergeometric P(X >= overlap): population 116736, successes = |C1 set| (neurons clearing BOTH nulls), draws = top 1 pct by C3 score (floor(0.01 * 116736) = 1167)
verdict_rule: C1 pass = fraction clearing BOTH nulls >= 0.005. C2 void if baseline < 0.5, else pass = top-64 accuracy < min over the 5 random arms. void (whole round) if the twin or the shuffled null is missing or the neuron grid is not 24 x 4864. C1 fail or C2 fail -> disproved; C1 pass and C2 pass -> proved; C1 pass and C2 void -> inconclusive. C3 scored separately (pass = p < 0.01), whatever the verdict.
